plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code dynamic workflow runs from the VS Code/Cursor extension: list, inspect, save, and re-run — the /workflows and Desktop tasks-pane experience for surfaces that lack it.

skills.name: dashboard
skills.description: Open the Workflows Conductor live dashboard — a localhost view of all Claude Code dynamic workflow runs across projects, with live per-agent updates. Use when the user wants to watch workflow runs, see a workflow dashboard, or monitor runs outside chat.
headings: /conductor:dashboard — live run dashboard, opened inside the IDE
skills.description_zh: 打开Workflows Conductor本地实时仪表盘，查看跨项目Claude Code动态工作流及各代理更新，适用于在聊天之外观察和监控运行。

skills.name: rerun
skills.description: Re-run a Claude Code dynamic workflow from a past run's script — a fresh run, useful for killed/failed runs or repeating a job. Use when the user wants to rerun, relaunch, retry, or restart a workflow run.
headings: /conductor:rerun — relaunch a run's script as a fresh workflow
skills.description_zh: 从历史运行脚本重新启动一次Claude Code动态工作流，适用于被终止或失败的运行及重复执行任务。

skills.name: save
skills.description: Save a Claude Code dynamic workflow run's script as a reusable slash-command workflow (the "s" action from the CLI /workflows panel). Use when the user wants to keep, save, or reuse a workflow run.
headings: /conductor:save — save a run as a reusable workflow
skills.description_zh: 将Claude Code动态工作流运行脚本保存为可复用的斜杠命令工作流，便于保留和再次使用。

skills.name: status
skills.description: List Claude Code dynamic workflow runs (status, agents, tokens, duration) by reading run records from ~/.claude/projects. Use when the user asks about workflow runs, ultracode runs, run status, or anything /workflows would show.
headings: /conductor:status — list and inspect dynamic workflow runs
skills.description_zh: 读取~/.claude/projects运行记录，列出Claude Code动态工作流的状态、代理、令牌消耗与耗时，展示/workflows面板所包含的信息。
